message.airplace.blocked: airplace is disabled on this server
options.airplace.title: airplace Settings
options.airplace.enabled.tooltip: Whether air placement is available now. The toggle key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.airplace.distance_note: Vanilla servers reject block placements more than about 5 blocks away.
options.airplace.min_distance.tooltip: The shortest placement distance the mouse wheel can select, in blocks from your eyes.
options.airplace.max_distance.tooltip: The longest placement distance the mouse wheel can select, in blocks from your eyes. Vanilla servers reject block placements more than about 5 blocks away.
options.airplace.scroll_step.tooltip: How many blocks one notch of the mouse wheel changes the placement distance while the Air Place Modifier key is held.
options.airplace.singleplayer_default.to: The state restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.airplace.multiplayer_default.too: The state restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.airplace.reset_on_world_exit.too: Every world starts from its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.airplace.reset_on_game_exit.tool: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default state.
options.airplace.multiplayer_warning: Servers may kick or ban you for placing blocks in mid-air. This mod does not try to bypass any anti-cheat.
options.airplace.multiplayer_default_off: It is disabled on all servers by default. Choose a mode below to use it on servers.
options.airplace.multiplayer_mode.whitel: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.airplace.multiplayer_mode.blackl: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.airplace.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.airplace.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.airplace: Lets the local player place blocks in mid-air.
